beginner.summary: For team members, managers and new practitioners joining a SAFe organisation. Covers why organisations scale, SAFe principles and configurations, agile teams and teams of teams, the Agile Release Train, PI Planning, iterations, the system demo, Inspect and Adapt, and the roles at team and train level, ending with a simulated PI Planning.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Scrum or Kanban
Has worked in a team of 5 to 10 people
outcomes: Explain SAFe principles, configurations and the Big Picture
Work as part of an agile team on an Agile Release Train
Take part in PI Planning, iterations, system demos and Inspect and Adapt
Describe the main SAFe roles and their responsibilities

days.topic: Why Scale Agile and SAFe Overview
subtopics: Business agility and the digital age
Configurations: Essential, Large Solution, Portfolio, Full
Where SAFe fits and where it does not
days.lab_task: Map a provided organisation's delivery problems to SAFe core competencies and choose the SAFe configuration that fits, with reasons.
days.deliverable: Problem map and configuration choice
checks: Each problem mapped with a reason
Choice justified by size and needs

days.topic: SAFe Lean-Agile Principles and Values
subtopics: Building incrementally with fast learning cycles
Visualising and limiting work in progress
days.lab_task: Analyse five decisions from a case study against the SAFe principles, recommend a better decision for each and present the economic reasoning for one.
days.deliverable: Decision analysis with principles
checks: Each linked to at least one principle
Classify decisions to centralise or decentralise

days.topic: Agile Teams in SAFe
days.lab_task: Set up a SAFe agile team with a team backlog, plan an iteration, run a team sync and hold an iteration review and retrospective in a simulation.
days.deliverable: Team backlog, iteration plan and event notes
checks: Stories fit capacity with iteration goals
objectives: Work as a SAFe agile team

days.topic: The Agile Release Train
subtopics: What an Agile Release Train is
Train roles: RTE, Product Management, System Architect, Business Owners
Develop on cadence, release on demand
days.lab_task: Design an Agile Release Train for a provided value stream: choose teams, roles, cadence and shared services, and draw the train.
days.deliverable: ART design diagram
checks: Each train role filled with responsibilities
Explain develop on cadence, release on demand

days.topic: Features, Enablers and the ART Backlog
days.lab_task: Write ten features with benefit hypotheses and acceptance criteria and two enablers for a train, split three features into stories and estimate them.
days.deliverable: ART backlog with features, enablers and stories
checks: Each has a benefit hypothesis and acceptance criteria

days.topic: Prioritising with Cost of Delay and WSJF
subtopics: Components: business value, time criticality, risk reduction
days.lab_task: Prioritise the train's features with WSJF in a group session, compare the order with a value-only order and explain the difference to Business Owners.
days.deliverable: WSJF table and explanation
checks: Differences explained by job size and delay

days.topic: Preparing for PI Planning
days.lab_task: Prepare a PI Planning event: complete a readiness checklist, write the vision briefing, select top features and calculate each team's capacity for the PI.
days.deliverable: Readiness checklist, briefing and capacity sheet
checks: All items done or with an owner
Vision, context and top features clear

days.topic: PI Planning Event: Team Breakouts and the Program Board
subtopics: Day one: business context and draft plans
Day two: adjustments and final plans
days.lab_task: Run a simulated two-day PI Planning for three teams with breakouts, a program board, management review, PI objectives with business value and a ROAM board.
days.deliverable: Team plans, program board, PI objectives and ROAM board
checks: Business value assigned by Business Owners
Every risk resolved, owned, accepted or mitigated

days.topic: Confidence Vote and Plan Rework
days.lab_task: Run a confidence vote after the simulated PI Planning, rework the plan for a low vote, define stretch objectives and run a short planning retrospective.
days.deliverable: Vote results, reworked plan and retrospective notes
checks: Confidence rises in the second vote

days.topic: Executing the PI: Iterations, ART Sync and Coordination
subtopics: ART sync: coach sync and PO sync
days.lab_task: Run three simulated iterations with ART syncs, track PI objectives on a board and handle a dependency slip and a priority change.
days.deliverable: ART sync notes and PI progress board

days.topic: The System Demo
days.lab_task: Run a system demo of an integrated increment from three teams in a role play, collect stakeholder feedback and link results to PI objectives.
days.deliverable: Demo notes and feedback log
checks: Work from all teams shown working together
Feedback logged and linked to features

days.topic: Built-In Quality and DevOps in SAFe
subtopics: Continuous exploration, integration, deployment, release on demand
days.lab_task: Map a train's current delivery pipeline, find the biggest delays and plan built-in quality and DevOps improvements for the next PI.
days.deliverable: Pipeline map and improvement plan
checks: Improvements fit into the PI as enablers

days.topic: Inspect and Adapt Workshop
subtopics: Root cause analysis with fishbone and five whys
days.lab_task: Run an Inspect and Adapt workshop for the simulated PI: review metrics, run a problem-solving workshop with root cause analysis and create improvement backlog items.
days.deliverable: Metrics review, root cause analysis and improvement items
checks: Planned versus actual business value shown
Each ready for the next PI Planning

days.topic: SAFe Roles: Scrum Master/Team Coach and Product Owner
days.lab_task: Work through ten scenarios for the Scrum Master/Team Coach and Product Owner, decide the right action for each and spot anti-patterns in a case train.
days.deliverable: Scenario decisions and anti-pattern notes
checks: At least eight match the answer key
At least three found with reasons
Explain the PO and Product Management split

days.topic: SAFe Roles: Release Train Engineer, Product Management and Business Owners
days.lab_task: Role-play a week on the train as RTE, Product Management and a Business Owner, handling an escalation, a scope request and a release decision.
days.deliverable: Role-play notes and decisions
checks: Decision based on WSJF and capacity
Based on quality and business value

days.topic: Lean-Agile Leadership
days.lab_task: Assess a case organisation's leaders against lean-agile leadership behaviours and write a development plan for one leader with specific actions.
days.deliverable: Leadership assessment and development plan
checks: Named with its effect on teams

days.topic: Lean Portfolio Management: Epics, Budgets and Guardrails
days.lab_task: Take an epic through the portfolio Kanban with a lean business case, an MVP and a go or pivot decision, and check spending against guardrails.
days.deliverable: Lean business case, portfolio Kanban and decision
checks: Make the go or pivot decision

days.topic: SAFe Measurement: Flow, Outcomes and Competency
subtopics: Measuring flow: velocity, time, load, efficiency, distribution, predictability
days.lab_task: Calculate flow metrics and ART predictability for the simulated PI, build a train dashboard and present three improvement insights.
days.deliverable: Metrics, dashboard and insights
checks: Each insight linked to an action

days.topic: Certified SAFe Agilist Exam Preparation
days.lab_task: Take a timed practice exam for the SAFe Agilist certification, review every wrong answer and plan final study.
days.deliverable: Practice score, review notes and study plan
checks: Each linked to a SAFe article
objectives: Prepare for the SAFe Agilist exam

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Simulated Program Increment
days.lab_task: Run a full simulated PI for a three-team train from preparation and PI Planning through iterations, system demo and Inspect and Adapt, then present the results and improvements.
days.deliverable: Program board, PI objectives, metrics, improvement items and a 10-minute presentation
checks: Improvement items ready for the next PI
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one PI
Work on an Agile Release Train

intermediate.summary: For SAFe Scrum Masters, Product Owners, Product Managers and new RTEs. Covers facilitating at train level, product management in SAFe, the Continuous Delivery Pipeline, release on demand, ART health, value stream identification, launching trains, large solutions, lean portfolio management in practice and role certifications.
prerequisites: Has taken part in at least one PI on an Agile Release Train
Knows SAFe events, roles and artefacts
Has worked as a Scrum Master, Product Owner or team member
outcomes: Facilitate train-level events and coach teams in SAFe
Manage features, roadmaps and releases as Product Owner or Product Manager
Identify value streams and launch Agile Release Trains
Run lean portfolio management and large solution coordination

days.topic: Facilitating Train-Level Events
subtopics: Running coach sync and PO sync
days.lab_task: Facilitate a management review during a simulated PI Planning where two teams disagree on scope, reach agreed adjustments and keep the event on schedule.
days.deliverable: Facilitation plan and outcome notes
checks: Adjustment agreed by both teams and Business Owners

days.topic: Coaching Teams on the Train
subtopics: SAFe Scrum Master/Team Coach as coach
days.lab_task: Run a team health assessment on three teams, choose coaching goals for each, hold one coaching session in a role play and define impact measures.
days.deliverable: Health assessments, coaching goals and impact measures

days.topic: Product Management in SAFe
days.lab_task: Define a product vision and a three-PI roadmap for a train based on customer research, write top features with benefit hypotheses and align them with Product Owners.
days.deliverable: Vision, roadmap and feature set
checks: Three PIs with themes and features
objectives: Act as Product Management in SAFe

days.topic: Design Thinking and Customer Centricity
days.lab_task: Build personas and a journey map for the train's main customer, prototype a feature and test it with users, then update the feature's benefit hypothesis.
days.deliverable: Personas, journey map, test results and updated feature
checks: Findings from at least three users

days.topic: Product Owner Practices in SAFe
days.lab_task: Manage a team backlog through a simulated PI: refine and accept stories, balance features and enablers, take part in PO syncs and report value delivered.
days.deliverable: Team backlog, PO sync notes and value report
checks: Business value delivered against PI objectives

days.topic: Release on Demand and the Continuous Delivery Pipeline
days.lab_task: Run a DevOps health radar assessment for the train, design a release-on-demand approach with feature toggles and plan pipeline improvements as enablers.
days.deliverable: Health radar, release approach and enabler plan

days.topic: Identifying Value Streams and Designing ARTs
days.lab_task: Run a value stream identification workshop for a provided company, identify development value streams and define the boundaries and teams of two ARTs.
days.deliverable: Value stream map and ART designs
checks: Teams organised around value with fewer dependencies

days.topic: Launching an Agile Release Train
days.lab_task: Plan the launch of a new ART: training schedule, readiness checklist, first PI Planning agenda and coaching plan for the first PI.
days.deliverable: Launch plan
checks: Every role trained before PI Planning

days.topic: ART Health and Continuous Improvement
days.lab_task: Analyse three PIs of train data, run an ART self-assessment, identify the top systemic impediment and plan improvements for the next PI.
days.deliverable: Analysis, self-assessment and improvement plan

days.topic: Managing Dependencies and Risks Across Trains
days.lab_task: Map dependencies between two ARTs, reduce them by redesigning one team's scope, track the rest on a shared board and ROAM cross-train risks.
days.deliverable: Dependency map, redesign and ROAM board
checks: Each has an owner and date

days.topic: Roadmapping and Forecasting Across Program Increments
subtopics: Forecasting with ART capacity and velocity
Capacity allocation across features, enablers and maintenance
Milestones: fixed date, learning and PI milestones
days.lab_task: Build a four-PI roadmap from the ART backlog using historical capacity, set a capacity allocation, mark fixed-date milestones and update the forecast after a simulated PI.
days.deliverable: Roadmap, capacity allocation and updated forecast
checks: Next PI committed and later PIs shown as forecasts
Percentages agreed for each work type
Forecast adjusted to the actual capacity

days.topic: Communities of Practice and the Innovation and Planning Iteration
subtopics: Communities of practice on the train
Infrastructure work in the IP iteration
days.lab_task: Plan an Innovation and Planning iteration with a hackathon, learning sessions and PI Planning preparation, and launch a testing community of practice with a charter.
days.deliverable: IP iteration plan and community charter
checks: Innovation, learning and planning all included
Purpose, members and meeting rhythm defined
IP iteration used as a buffer for late work is named and avoided

days.topic: Large Solution SAFe
days.lab_task: Design a solution train of three ARTs and a supplier, write capabilities and split them into features, and run a simulated Pre-Plan.
days.deliverable: Solution train design, capabilities and Pre-Plan outcome
checks: Each split into features across ARTs
Top capabilities agreed for the next PI

days.topic: Lean Portfolio Management in Practice
days.lab_task: Complete a portfolio canvas, run a participatory budgeting event across three value streams and hold a portfolio sync with epic progress.
days.deliverable: Portfolio canvas, budget allocation and sync notes

days.topic: Agile Contracts and Supplier Collaboration in SAFe
days.lab_task: Rework a fixed-scope supplier contract into a SAFe-friendly agile contract and include the supplier in a simulated PI Planning.
days.deliverable: Contract outline and PI Planning notes
checks: PI-based commitments and adaptive scope included
Supplier plans and dependencies on the program board

days.topic: Compliance, Architecture and Governance in SAFe
days.lab_task: Plan the architectural runway and compliance enablers for a regulated train, set up traceability for a feature and prepare evidence for an audit.
days.deliverable: Runway plan, traceability and audit evidence
checks: Enablers ahead of the features that need them
Requirement to tests to release traced

days.topic: Metrics and Reporting for Trains and Portfolios
days.lab_task: Build a dashboard for two trains and a portfolio with flow, predictability and OKR progress, and present it to a mock executive team with actions.
days.deliverable: Dashboard and executive presentation
checks: One risky metric and the safeguard named

days.topic: Remote and Hybrid SAFe
days.lab_task: Plan a remote PI Planning for a train across three time zones with a digital program board and engagement techniques, and run a remote session.
days.deliverable: Remote PI Planning plan and session results
checks: Works across the three time zones

days.topic: Role Certification Preparation: SSM and POPM
days.lab_task: Take timed practice exams for SSM and POPM, review wrong answers and plan final study.
days.deliverable: Practice scores, review notes and study plan
checks: Each linked to a SAFe article

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Launch and Run an Agile Release Train
subtopics: Value stream identification and ART design
days.lab_task: Identify a value stream, design and launch an ART in a simulation, build the vision, roadmap and backlog, run PI Planning and a PI, hold Inspect and Adapt and present results to leadership.
days.deliverable: ART design, launch plan, program board, metrics and a 15-minute presentation
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one train launch
Run a PI end to end

advanced.summary: For RTEs, SAFe Practice Consultants, agile coaches and transformation leaders. Covers leading SAFe implementations, the implementation roadmap, executive coaching, portfolio and enterprise strategy, organisational agility, value stream management, SAFe for government and regulated sectors, AI-enabled business agility, measuring business outcomes and avoiding SAFe anti-patterns.
prerequisites: Has worked on an Agile Release Train for several PIs in a leading role
Knows SAFe roles, events and portfolio practices well
Has led change or coaching work
outcomes: Lead SAFe implementations from strategy to sustained improvement
Coach executives and design enterprise portfolios
Measure business outcomes and avoid common SAFe failures
Adapt SAFe to the organisation instead of copying it

days.topic: Leading a SAFe Implementation: The Implementation Roadmap
subtopics: Creating a Lean-Agile Center of Excellence
days.lab_task: Build an implementation plan for a 2,000-person organisation following the roadmap, with a Lean-Agile Center of Excellence, training waves and ART launch sequence.
days.deliverable: Implementation plan and LACE charter
checks: Every roadmap step has activities and dates
objectives: Build a Lean-Agile Center of Excellence

days.topic: Tailoring SAFe to the Organisation
subtopics: SAFe as a framework, not a recipe
Case studies of good and bad tailoring
days.lab_task: Tailor SAFe for a mid-sized company with two value streams, decide which roles, events and artefacts to adopt or skip and justify each decision.
days.deliverable: Tailoring decisions with reasons
checks: Linked to a principle or a business need
No layer without a clear purpose

days.topic: Coaching Executives and Leadership Teams
subtopics: Building the case for change with executives
days.lab_task: Coach a mock executive team through a strategy-to-portfolio conversation, handle resistance from one executive and agree leadership commitments for the next PI.
days.deliverable: Coaching notes and leadership commitments

days.topic: Enterprise Strategy and Portfolio Alignment
days.lab_task: Translate an enterprise strategy into strategic themes and OKRs for two portfolios, align funding and run a strategic portfolio review with adjustments.
days.deliverable: Themes, OKRs, funding plan and review record
checks: Linked from enterprise to portfolio level

days.topic: Value Stream Management and Flow Optimisation
tools: Value stream management tool or Excel
days.lab_task: Map a development value stream end to end, measure flow time and efficiency, find the bottleneck across trains and plan improvements with measures.
days.deliverable: Value stream map, flow measures and improvement plan

days.topic: Organisational Agility and Operating Model Design
days.lab_task: Design the target operating model for a business unit adopting SAFe, including business teams on the train, HR and finance changes and governance.
days.deliverable: Operating model design
checks: Business teams included on the train
Lighter governance with clear decision rights

days.topic: Measuring Business Outcomes in SAFe
days.lab_task: Build an outcome measurement framework for a portfolio with customer, business and flow measures, report a year of simulated results and recommend investment changes.
days.deliverable: Measurement framework, report and recommendations

days.topic: SAFe Anti-Patterns and Recovery
subtopics: Common anti-patterns: SAFe as a reporting layer, fake ARTs, PI as waterfall
days.lab_task: Diagnose anti-patterns in three troubled SAFe implementations, choose recovery strategies and write a reset plan for one.
days.deliverable: Diagnoses, strategies and reset plan

days.topic: SAFe in Government and Regulated Industries
days.lab_task: Adapt SAFe for a government programme with fixed annual budgets and audit requirements, plan compliance enablers and design reporting for oversight bodies.
days.deliverable: Adapted approach, compliance plan and oversight reports

days.topic: Architecture and Technical Strategy at Scale
days.lab_task: Plan a legacy modernisation across three trains with platform teams, architectural runway enablers and technical health measures, and record the main decisions.
days.deliverable: Modernisation plan, enablers and decision records

days.topic: AI and Business Agility in SAFe
subtopics: AI in SAFe roles and events
AI for backlog and feature work
AI products on Agile Release Trains
days.lab_task: Use AI to draft features and PI Planning briefings, check every output, design a responsible AI policy for the train and plan how to measure AI's effect on flow.
days.deliverable: AI drafts with checks, AI policy and measurement plan
checks: Data, checking and approval rules included

days.topic: Business Agility Assessment and Maturity Roadmaps
subtopics: Running assessments with teams and leaders
days.lab_task: Run a business agility assessment with a case leadership team, prioritise two competencies, build a 12-month growth roadmap and set outcome measures for each.
days.deliverable: Assessment results, roadmap and measures
checks: Scores for all seven competencies with evidence
Each competency goal has a measure

days.topic: Innovation and Continuous Learning at Enterprise Scale
days.lab_task: Design an innovation funnel for a portfolio with innovation epics, MVPs and innovation accounting, run one epic through it in a simulation and decide to pivot or persevere.
days.deliverable: Innovation funnel, MVP results and decision
checks: Leading indicators set for the MVP

days.topic: Running Large PI Planning Events
subtopics: Planning events for hundreds of people
days.lab_task: Plan a multi-ART PI Planning for 300 people across sites, run a simulated management review with a major conflict and measure event effectiveness.
days.deliverable: Event plan, conflict resolution and effectiveness measures

days.topic: Developing Change Agents and SPCs
days.lab_task: Design a programme to grow 20 internal change agents including SPCs, with training, mentoring, communities of practice and measures of capacity.
days.deliverable: Change agent programme

days.topic: Comparing SAFe with Other Approaches and Hybrid Scaling
subtopics: SAFe versus LeSS, Nexus and Scrum@Scale in depth
days.lab_task: Evaluate whether a provided organisation should adopt full SAFe, parts of SAFe or another approach, and present the recommendation with evidence.
days.deliverable: Evaluation and recommendation

days.topic: Financial Governance and Lean Budgeting at Scale
subtopics: Moving from project to value stream funding
days.lab_task: Plan the move from project funding to value stream funding for a portfolio, including capitalisation rules, guardrails and a transition plan agreed with finance.
days.deliverable: Funding model, capitalisation rules and transition plan

days.topic: Certification Preparation: SAFe RTE and SPC
subtopics: Teaching SAFe courses as an SPC
days.lab_task: Take timed practice exams for RTE and SPC, review wrong answers and plan final study and teaching practice.
days.deliverable: Practice scores, review notes and plan
checks: Each linked to a SAFe article
Study and teaching practice dates set

days.topic: Troubleshooting Stalled SAFe Transformations
days.lab_task: Diagnose two stalled SAFe transformations from data and interviews, design reset plans and write a reset message for leaders.
days.deliverable: Diagnoses, reset plans and reset message

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: SAFe Transformation Strategy for an Enterprise
days.lab_task: Produce a SAFe transformation strategy for an enterprise with an assessment, value streams and ARTs, tailored roadmap, portfolio and funding model, leadership plan and outcome measures, then present it to a mock executive team.
days.deliverable: Strategy document, roadmap, funding model and a 20-minute executive presentation
checks: Each justified by need or principle
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one strategy
